name: Wolf
otherStatistics: Initiative +2 (12). Proficiency Bonus +2. Darkvision 60 ft.. Languages none.
appearance: A gray-brown wolf with pointed ears, a pale muzzle and a thick tail.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Monster Manual (2025), 2024 rules, p. 373. https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/4775850-wolf
sections.Traits: Pack Tactics. The wolf has Advantage on attacks against a creature when at least one of the wolf's allies is within 5 ft. of that creature and the ally is not Incapacitated.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee attack +4, reach 5 ft. On a hit, deal 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage. A Medium or smaller creature hit by the bite falls Prone.

name: Brontosaurus
otherStatistics: AC includes natural armor. Languages none.
appearance: A massive four-legged dinosaur with a long neck, small head and long tapering tail.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Volo's Guide to Monsters, November 2016 first printing, p. 139.
sections.Actions:
Stomp. Melee weapon attack +8, reach 20 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 27 (5d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage. The target falls prone on a failed DC 14 Strength saving throw.
Tail. Melee weapon attack +8, reach 20 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 32 (6d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

name: Cranium Rat
appearance: A single dark-furred rat with a bare pink tail and an exposed pink brain.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Volo's Guide to Monsters, November 2016 first printing, p. 133.
sections.Traits: Telepathic Shroud. The rat is immune to effects that sense its emotions or read its thoughts. It is also immune to all divination spells.
sections.Bonus actions: Illumination. Use a bonus action to emit dim light in a 5-ft. radius from the brain or put out the light.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee weapon attack +4, reach 5 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 1 piercing damage.
sections.Cranium rat lore: A rat separated from its swarm starts with Intelligence 15 and loses 1 point each day it remains apart, to a minimum of 4. Joining its original swarm or another swarm restores Intelligence to 15. A lone rat of low intelligence uses telepathy to communicate basic emotions and needs.

name: Deinonychus
otherStatistics: AC includes natural armor. Languages none.
appearance: A lean green dinosaur with a stiff tail, narrow jaws and curved claws.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Volo's Guide to Monsters, November 2016 first printing, p. 139.
sections.Traits: Pounce. Move at least 20 ft. straight toward a creature and hit it with a claw attack on the same turn. The creature falls prone on a failed DC 12 Strength saving throw. If the target is prone, the deinonychus can make one bite attack against it as a bonus action.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack +4, reach 5 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.
Claw. Melee weapon attack +4, reach 5 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 6 (1d8 + 2) slashing damage.

name: Dimetrodon
otherStatistics: AC includes natural armor. Languages none.
appearance: A squat, long-tailed reptile with strong jaws and a tall rust-colored sail on its back.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Volo's Guide to Monsters, November 2016 first printing, p. 139.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee weapon attack +4, reach 5 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 9 (2d6 + 2) piercing damage.
